commits.body:

Source port for vLLM v0.34.0. Existing notices and SPDX headers are retained.

r17_sources.subject: Support software FP8 cache conversions on Ampere
r17_sources.body:
Retain the upstream cache layouts and use software E4M3 conversion on
devices without native FP8 casts. Gate CuTe dispatch by capability and
cover the new V4.1 cache gather and insertion kernels as well.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Add exact bit-based E4M3FN decode for sparse attention
r17_sources.body:
Provide an opt-in decoder using exponent rebiasing and exact subnormal conversion. Keep the existing software decoder as the default.

Origin: Local SM80 sparse attention optimization
Upstream: Not submitted; GPU qualification pending

commits.subject: Port Ampere sparse indexer and attention paths
commits.body:
Origin: r17 vLLM patches 0002, 0003, 0011, 0013, 0017, 0018, 0023.

Source port for vLLM v0.34.0. Existing notices and SPDX headers are retained.

r17_sources.subject: Add an Ampere fallback for sparse indexer scoring
r17_sources.body:
Use BF16 Triton MQA scoring when DeepGEMM cannot execute. Bound
prefill logits by row chunks and use torch top-k to avoid unsupported
persistent kernels. Use fixed launch configs during CUDA capture.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Connect DeepSeek V4.1 sparse attention on SM80
r17_sources.body:
Select the BF16 Triton sparse path on SM80 and retain grouped WO_A
weights for MXFP8 emulation. Share current metadata and attention fixes
with ROCm without probing AMD devices on CUDA. Keep upstream mHC dispatch.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Enable device-trimmed DSpark indexer rows on Ampere
r17_sources.body:
Advertise device/host query-length mismatch support for the V4.1 Ampere
indexer. Reuse the existing device metadata kernel to expand each query's
causal bound and block-table row into persistent buffers, including graph
padding, before the Triton MQA fallback consumes single-query rows.

Keep native DeepGEMM varlen support separate and retain the original
metadata path when adaptive verification is disabled. Force flattening
for adaptive two-row batches as well as the usual six-row DSpark shape.
Cover the architecture, model and opt-in gates with CPU unit tests.

Origin: new
Upstream: none
Assisted-by: OpenAI Codex

r17_sources.subject: Add opt-in offline-tuned sparse decode on SM80
r17_sources.body:
Reuse BF16 tensor-core split-K and softmax reduction over both paged KV segments. Select fixed launch parameters by row/head/index capacities, validate the device-specific table before capture, and retain the original default. Honor inverse RoPE requests throughout the opt-in path and write BF16 output directly.

Origin: Local SM80 sparse attention optimization; shared ROCm Triton kernels
Upstream: Not submitted; GPU qualification pending

r17_sources.subject: Add opt-in SM80 prefill indexer reuse and fused postprocessing
r17_sources.body:
Reuse BF16 Q and K conversion across row chunks; expose fixed N tiles and keep torch.topk selection while fusing relative-index sorting and padding. All new paths default off.

Origin: Local SM80 prefill optimization

Upstream: Not submitted; operator GPU validation pending


Signed-off-by: Adrien Brault <adrien.brault@gmail.com>

r17_sources.subject: Allow SM80 indexer row sharding with candidate propagation
r17_sources.body:
Opt in to row sharding for two-level candidate writers and consumers. Exchange source candidate rows as well as final top-k indices; retain the existing sharding threshold and safety predicates.

Origin: Local SM80 prefill optimization

Upstream: Not submitted; operator GPU validation pending


Signed-off-by: Adrien Brault <adrien.brault@gmail.com>

r17_sources.subject: Apply the inverse RoPE in the un-tuned sparse decode fallback
r17_sources.body:
The fallback decode kernel used on Ampere (and on ROCm parts other than
gfx942/gfx950) has no rotating epilogue, yet rocm_sparse_attn_decode returns
the full row count as rotated whenever inv_rope_positions is supplied. The
caller then skips its standalone inverse RoPE, so every decode row reaches
wo_a unrotated. On 4x SM80 cards with DSpark this produced degenerate greedy
text after the prefill tokens and a mean acceptance length of about 1.3.

Rotate the fallback's output rows in place when positions are supplied.

Origin: new

commits.subject: Port SSD Engram and pipeline source shadows
commits.body:
Origin: r17 vLLM patches 0003, 0004, 0005, 0021.

Contains shared model initialization, loading, TP logits, and TBO state hooks used by later patches. Native SSD row-store source is carried byte for byte from r17 patch 0004.

r17_sources.body:
Select the BF16 Triton sparse path on SM80 and retain grouped WO_A

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Serve V4.1 Engram rows from bounded SSD storage
r17_sources.body:
Keep full embedding tables out of host and device allocations. Use
the existing threaded pread row store and stream-ordered host callback
with upstream hashing, head sharding and BF16 staging. Load tables
from a separate checkpoint root and retain strict real-weight checks.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; r5 patch 0006; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Forward V4.1 shared cache sources across pipeline cuts
r17_sources.body:
Instantiate attention-only shadows before local consumers, ship their
normalized source inputs and candidate blocks, and load duplicated
source weights under shadow names. Use the V2 runner aux-state relay
for DSpark instead of maintaining a separate V1 proposer.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Overlap whole-request V4.1 TP4 verify microbatches with upstream DBO
r17_sources.body:
Keep non-causal DSpark queries intact; pack ragged rows into stable half-batch buffers for FULL graphs and use event-ordered TP reductions on the DBO communication stream. Isolate indexer, Engram and MTP state and add an optional live output gate.

Origin: dsv41 overlap round r17
Upstream: local opt-in SM80 experiment

commits.subject: Port DSpark shard loading and staged Marlin repacking
commits.body:
Origin: r17 vLLM patches 0006, 0007, 0026-filter-dspark-unused-shards.patch.

The DSpark model also supplies local-vocabulary logits used by patch 0006.

r17_sources.subject: Load a private DSpark embedding on the last pipeline rank
r17_sources.body:
The target input embedding is absent from the last pipeline stage.
Load its checkpoint tensor into the draft there and declare ownership
so upstream sharing keeps it. Tensor parallel execution still aliases
the target embedding and output head through upstream utilities.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp; new
Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Stage Ampere MXFP4 MoE repacking through host memory
r17_sources.body:
Release the raw GPU expert tensor before allocating its Marlin copy.
Repack one expert at a time using pageable host staging, preserving
scale and bias permutations while limiting draft-load GPU peaks.

Origin: dsv41reap-pp
Upstream: none

r17_sources.purpose: Opt-in DSpark unused checkpoint shard filter

r17_sources.body:
Report live, reserved, split and external GPU memory per PP/TP rank
after loading and profiling. Keep the recipe debug switches usable with

r17_sources.body:
Match the two-stream helper when capturing a breakable segment: run

eager break with pending side-stream work.

Upstream: none

r17_sources.subject: Add opt-in vocabulary-parallel sampling for V4.1 DSpark
r17_sources.body:
Keep target and draft head logits sharded for greedy and seeded Gumbel
sampling. Merge bounded top-k/nucleus candidates only when coverage is
certified, otherwise retain the dense batch path. Compute rejection token
probabilities and residual draws with scalar reductions and local logits.

Share request seeds, preserve raw local proposal caches, and materialize
them for unsupported batches. Include CPU math gates, GPU integration
checks, and a four-rank sampling-stage benchmark. Defaults are unchanged.

Origin: Local offline TP4 sampling implementation
Upstream: Not submitted; requires GPU qualification and human review

commits.subject: Port SM80 mHC kernels and prefill MoE chunking
commits.body:
Origin: r17 vLLM patches 0019, 0020, 0025.

Source port for vLLM v0.34.0. Existing notices and SPDX headers are retained.

r17_sources.subject: Pipeline opt-in SM80 EXL3 prefill compute and reductions
r17_sources.body:
Move only the final MoE reduction out of the fused runner and pipeline balanced token chunks with PyNCCL on a side stream. Restrict the path to SM80 TP4 EXL3 without EP, DP or ubatching; serialize decode and capture. Provide a strict live-layer parity gate.

Origin: Local TP4 prefill overlap experiment

Upstream: Not submitted; operator GPU validation pending


Signed-off-by: Adrien Brault <adrien.brault@gmail.com>

r17_sources.subject: Add opt-in SM80 kernels for delayed mHC decode seams
r17_sources.body:
Fuse post mapping with a SIMT split-K projection and use a vectorized
carried-mix RMSNorm epilogue for V4.1 decode rows. Add tiled standalone
post, fixed configuration selection, CPU arithmetic checks and an offline
GPU correctness/graph benchmark and tuner. Keep the existing path by
default and for large rows. GPU qualification is pending.

Origin: dsv41-mhc-r14
Upstream: Not submitted; SM80 hardware qualification pending

r17_sources.subject: Preserve FP32 projection values at the SM80 fused mHC seam
r17_sources.body:
The upstream fused post/pre projects the FP32 post-mix registers while storing BF16 residual streams. Rounding those registers before projection adds coefficient error that cannot be fixed by changing the gate tolerance. Follow the upstream dispatch decision so the separate post/pre range still projects BF16.

Validate against a float64 oracle, retain both sides of failed comparisons in the GPU gate, and cover the fused-to-separate boundary with CPU interpretation of the Triton bodies. GPU qualification remains pending.

Origin: dsv41-gatefix-r19
Upstream: Not submitted; SM80 hardware qualification pending

commits.subject: Port post-r17 serving layers
commits.body:
